summary: Reads a DWORD vehicle data field through a double indirection: loads the vehicle object pointer stored at this+0x0, then reads the DWORD at vehicle object offset 0xF8C and returns it as an int. No guard, no callee. Invoked on the per-frame path by telemetry, render, particle and weather systems to sample a live vehicle scalar.

local_names.this: owner object holding the vehicle object pointer

operations.description: Read the vehicle object pointer stored at this+0x0 (double-indirection base for the accessor)
Dereference the vehicle object pointer and return the DWORD at vehicle object offset 0xF8C as an integer

Per-frame data accessor sampled by TelemetryDisplaySwitch (0047DBE0), ArithmeticComparison_9fb0 (004B9FB0), RenderTickUpdate (004C8B70), sub_4CC970 (004CC970), ParticleEffectPhysics (004CCB30), ParticleSpawnFunction (004CCE90), ParticleSystemUpdateWithWindAndDamping (004CD220), WheelContactParticle (004CD6C0) and WeatherParticleUpdate (004CFCC0)

unresolved: The exact meaning of the field at vehicle object offset 0xF8C (speed, gear, or another scalar) is not documented in this packet
The owner object type behind this+0x0 is unlabeled
